outcome: fetal growth patterns (head circumference, abdominal circumference, femur length, HC/AC ratio, estimated fetal weight)
cohort: Seventy pregnancies involving isolated fetal gastroschisis, diagnosed before week 24, were examined retrospectively.
finding: Fetuses with gastroschisis present a reduced growth pattern without recovery, and a head circumference measurement below the 10th percentile between weeks 26 and 31+6 is predictive of low birth weight.
cross-section timing: Period I: weeks 20-25+6; Period II: weeks 26-31+6; Period III: from week 32 until term.
birth_weight: Prediction of low birth weight (below 10th percentile)
gest_age: Inclusion before week 24; measurements taken between weeks 20 and term.
